network.offline: Offline · you can keep entering grades; they will be sent when the network is back.
network.offlinePending: Offline · entries waiting to be sent: {{count}}. You can keep entering grades.

classrooms.title: Your classes, sorted by school
classrooms.text: Each class belongs to a school, named at the top of the class screen: two schools never get mixed up.

offline.title: Grade entry carries on without a network
offline.text: Grades are saved on the phone and sent when the network is back. A banner always tells you how many entries are waiting.

parents.title: Each parent follows their child
parents.text: You invite a parent with a 6-digit code, sent by SMS or email. They see their child's grades in your subject, never those of other students.

reportCards.title: Averages, never a rank
reportCards.text: Report cards show the student's averages and, for each subject, the class average — never a rank. Submitting them to the school management stays your decision.

errors.unknown-account: No account uses {{identifier}}. Check it or create an account.
errors.existing-account: An account already uses {{identifier}}. Sign in with it instead.
errors.wrong-code: This code does not match the one sent. Check the message or ask for a new code.
errors.unknown-invitation: This code matches no current invitation. Check the message you received or ask the teacher for a new code.
errors.offline: Offline · sending and checking the code need the network. Try again when it is back.
errors.invitation-declined: No link was made. Ask the teacher to check the student concerned, then enter the new code.
errors.parental-consent-required: A consent required for this invitation is missing. Go back, continue again and tick each box shown.
errors.consents-declined: No link was made: without the consents requested, your child cannot be followed in @makola. If you change your mind, enter the code again before it expires.
errors.unexpected: The server did not answer. Try again in a moment.

country.title: Calling code
country.text: It sets your country: you will not be asked for it again.

welcome.promise: Your students' grades, entered and kept on your phone — with or without a network.
welcome.parent: Parent? Enter the code you received

phone.title: Create your account
phone.text: Your number is enough. A 6-digit code will be sent to you: no password to remember.

email.title: Create your account
email.text: Your address is enough. A 6-digit code will be sent to you: no password to remember.

phone.title: Your number
phone.text: A 6-digit code will be sent to you: no password to remember.

email.title: Your email address
email.text: A 6-digit code will be sent to you: no password to remember.

phone.title: Your number
phone.text: It is used to sign in and to receive alerts. A confirmation code will be sent to you.

email.title: Your email address
email.text: It is used to sign in. A confirmation code will be sent to you.

identifier.phoneRequired: Enter your number on the keypad.
identifier.phoneFormat: A mobile number (+{{code}}) starts with {{prefixes}}. Erase and correct it or change the calling code.
identifier.phoneComplete: Number complete. The code will be sent by SMS.
identifier.phoneProgress: {{total}} digits after the calling code · {{count}} of {{total}}.
identifier.emailRequired: Enter your address to receive the code.
identifier.emailFormat: Part of the address is missing: it looks like firstname.lastname@example.com.
identifier.emailHint: The code will be sent by email.

code.sentTo: Sent to {{identifier}}. It expires in 10 minutes.
code.resendIn: Nothing received? You can ask for a new code in {{seconds}} s.

invitation.title: Invitation code
invitation.text: The 6-digit code sent by your child's teacher, by SMS or email.
invitation.validity: The code is valid for 7 days and works only once.

child.title: Your child
child.subtitle: Step 1 of 3 · Check
child.intro: Check before continuing: this code links your account to a single student.
child.youWillSee: You will see {{name}}'s grades, announced tests and report cards in {{subject}}.
child.neverOthers: Never the grades of other students.

consents.title: Your consent
consents.subtitle: Step 2 of 3 · Consent
consents.intro: Before the code is sent, @makola asks for your consent on each point below. Every box must be ticked to follow {{name}}.

CHILD_DATA.title: {{name}}'s school data
CHILD_DATA.text: You agree that @makola processes {{name}}'s school data: name, class, grades, announced tests and report cards.

CROSS_BORDER_TRANSFER.title: Storage outside Kenya
CROSS_BORDER_TRANSFER.text: You agree that your link with {{name}}, and {{name}}'s school data, are stored in Europe, outside Kenya.

consents.withdrawal: You can withdraw each consent later: the link with {{name}} then ends, and you will no longer see their grades.

alerts.title: Your alerts
alerts.subtitle: Can be changed at any time
alerts.intro: Choose what you receive by SMS about {{name}}.
alerts.noSms: No SMS: you will check the feed yourself.
alerts.smsPerMonth: About {{count}} SMS a month with these settings.
alerts.guarantee: Turning an alert off never removes access: the feed stays available.

newGrade.label: New grade
newGrade.detail: As soon as the teacher publishes a graded assignment.

gradeBelowPass.label: Grade below the pass mark
gradeBelowPass.detail: Half the scale: {{mark20}} out of 20, {{mark10}} out of 10, {{mark5}} out of 5.

reportCardAvailable.label: Report card available
reportCardAvailable.detail: Once a term, or once a semester at university.

identity.title: Who are you?
identity.subtitle: Step 1 of 3 · Identity
identity.intro: Your name as parents and schools will read it.

subjects.title: Your subjects
subjects.subtitle: Step 2 of 3 · Teaching
subjects.intro: What you teach, and at which level. You can add more later.

city.title: Where do you teach?
city.subtitle: Step 3 of 3 · City
city.intro: Your city is enough: you will never be asked for your exact address.

profile.cityHint: Your city only, never your exact address.

errors.city: Enter the city where you teach.

classroom.noMatch: No student is named “{{query}}”. Try a last name alone or clear the search.

reportCardNotice.term: The term {{n}} report card will be available once the term closes, on {{date}}. It will show, for each subject, the class average beside the student's, and no rank.
reportCardNotice.semester: The semester {{n}} report card will be available once the semester closes, on {{date}}. It will show, for each subject, the class average beside the student's, and no rank.

titleErrors.empty: Give it a title: it is what students and parents will see.
titleErrors.tooShort: Too short to be recognised in the list of assignments: 3 characters minimum.

duplicate.term: “{{title}}” already exists in this class this term. Change the number or the date.
duplicate.semester: “{{title}}” already exists in this class this semester. Change the number or the date.

titleErrors.tooLong: {{max}} characters maximum: beyond that, the title is cut off on the report card.
titleErrors.long: Long for a report card: readable, but tight.

coefficient.max: Maximum coefficient. Beyond it, a single assignment would decide the average.
coefficient.weight: Weighs {{count}} times as much as a coefficient 1 assignment.

afterClose.term: After term {{n}} closes: this assignment will count for term {{next}}.
afterClose.semester: After semester {{n}} closes: this assignment will count for semester {{next}}.

afterLastClose.term: After term {{n}} closes, the last of the school year: no term of this class follows. Check the date.
afterLastClose.semester: After semester {{n}} closes, the last of the academic year: no semester of this class follows. Check the date.

closed.term: Term {{n}} is closed. Choose a date after {{after}}.
closed.semester: Semester {{n}} is closed. Choose a date after {{after}}.
